FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro:
I'm the eldest of the BIRD BROTHERS.
The best thing about birds… It has to be the beak.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostB: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from here.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro:
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD BROTHERS.
The best thing about birds… It has to be the wings.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostB: There was a really somber guy over that way.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldInt:
I'm the youngest of the BIRD BROTHERS.
The best thing about birds… It has to be the down.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDef: Down is so comfy… It makes me drowsy…
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPos: It fills me with happiness when bird POKéMON beg playfully…
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhe: This is where I buried my ONIX… It was named TECTONIX…
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT:
“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved on a boulder.
There is a LEMONADE placed as an offering in front of the grave.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnot: Would you like to leave another LEMONADE as an offering?
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCan: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE in front of the grave.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouP:
Th-thank you…
That was my TECTONIX's favorite drink…
I don't even know you, but your act of kindness…
It's uplifted me a little.
Can you please take this as my thanks?
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToY: Please be good to your POKéMON, too.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveR: If you don't have room for it, I'll hold it for you till next time.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHave:
Oh, it's you from that time…
I still have that thing I wanted you to have as my thanks.
FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT:
Boulders and rocks are neatly piled up as a cairn.
“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved on a boulder.
